verifactu.title: Check Veri*Factu records
verifactu.scope: This tool signs and checks records supplied by invoicing software. It does not generate or store records, or submit them to the AEAT.
verifactu.limit: The size or complexity limit has been exceeded.
verifactu.xml: The XML is invalid. DTDs and external entities are not allowed.
verifactu.root: The root must be RegistroAlta, RegistroAnulacion or RegistroEvento in the AEAT namespace.

verifactu.value: The value does not meet the format, length or allowed values in the schema.
verifactu.profile: The signature does not meet the enveloped XAdES profile with AGE policy and RSA-SHA256 or RSA-SHA512.
verifactu.key: An RSA key with a valid certificate suitable for signing is required.

verifactu.qr_notice: Reading the URL sends no data. Query AEAT sends only the issuer ID, number, date and amount from the QR. This version accepts URLs, not images or PDFs.
verifactu.qr_url: The URL must use HTTPS and an official AEAT verification host and path, with no port, user information or fragment.
verifactu.qr_params: The QR must contain only nif, numserie, fecha and importe, each once and correctly formatted.
verifactu.qr_service: The AEAT query timed out or returned an invalid response.
